lore: Every island that ties up at DiskSaver harbour signs the pier register: its quest, its keeper's name, where its rules are posted and which workshop built it. Pier Registrar Abelard reads the register end to end each evening. He refuses a berth to any island with a torn page or a quest already taken, and he queries, politely, when two keepers answer to the same name or an island's rules are nowhere to be found.

lines.registered: Every berth signed, every keeper named once. The register is in order.
lines.queried: All berths are valid, but I have queries: keepers sharing a name, or rules I cannot find.
lines.unregistered: A torn page or a quest taken twice. No berth until the register is put right.
